name: Café Conversation (2 speakers)
description: Two characters having a conversation in a café setting

environment.summary: a warm, sunlit café with exposed brick walls, wooden tables, and ambient chatter
environment.lighting: warm natural window light from the left, soft shadows

style: cinematic with shallow depth of field and warm color grading

shots.camera: Medium two-shot from across the table
shots.action: {A} sits across from {B}, holding a coffee cup. {A} leans forward and speaks.

shots.camera: Close-up of {B}, shallow depth of field
shots.action: {B} listens with interest, then responds with a slight smile.

shots.camera: Medium shot favoring {A}, {B} slightly out of focus
shots.action: {A} reacts to {B}'s response, laughs warmly, and picks up the coffee cup.

overall_soundscape: Soft café ambience with quiet background chatter, espresso machine hiss, and the occasional clink of cups.
